# polaris_policy (Data Source)

Fetches a Polaris policy.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "polaris_policy" "compaction" {
  catalog   = "lakehouse"
  namespace = ["governance"]
  name      = "nightly-compaction"
}

output "compaction_config" {
  value = jsondecode(data.polaris_policy.compaction.content)
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `catalog` (String) The name of the catalog.
- `name` (String) The name of the policy.
- `namespace` (List of String) Namespace the policy is defined in, as an ordered list of levels.

### Read-Only

- `content` (String) The policy definition, a JSON document validated against the schema of `type` (use `jsonencode`). Polaris stores it as written.
- `description` (String) Description of the policy.
- `inheritable` (Boolean) Whether the policy applies to the children of the entities it is attached to. Set by Polaris from the policy type.
- `type` (String) The policy type: `system.data-compaction`, `system.metadata-compaction`, `system.orphan-file-removal` or `system.snapshot-expiry`. Changing this forces a new resource.
- `version` (Number) Version of the policy, incremented on every update.
